component_inspections.details: Direct conversational interface with AssistantRuntimeProvider (@assistant-ui/react). Connects to SSE streaming endpoint api.streamAgentChat, handles file attachments via api.getAttachments/api.uploadFiles, and directory picker via api.pickAgentFolder.

Central Agent Office screen orchestrating roster matrix, war room lanes, agent environment controls, direct chat, and task dispatching. Properly types AgentOfficeMember and matches backend state endpoints.
Thread rendering component integrating Assistant UI primitives, prompt-kit message cards, and Blobatar avatars. Types and bindings strictly compliant.
Agent configuration modal for editing skills, risk tiers, model, engine, desk coordinates, and personality. Correctly posts AgentProfile payload via api.saveAgent.
Sub-view component for editing individual agent files and configuration.
Agent table list view with actions for chat, edit, delete, and folder navigation.
